decision.title: = (Tour Edition)
tracklist: The Joker and the Queen (feat. Taylor Swift)
Bad Habits (feat. Bring Me the Horizon)

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (23 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%3D_(album), http://capitalfm.com/news/ed-sheeran-equals-tour-edition/. CORRECTION to the assumed bonus list: released 27 May 2022; Wikipedia documents 23 tracks (14 standard + 9 bonus). Bonus tracks are: Afterglow; One Life and Penguins (both from the 2019 film 'Yesterday', previously unreleased); two brand-new songs I Will Remember You and Welcome to the World; the Taylor Swift version of The Joker and the Queen; 2step (feat. Lil Baby); Bad Habits (feat. Bring Me the Horizon); Peru (with Fireboy DML). Note: several countries got a 24th track — a second 2step remix (Potter Payper in the UK per Capital FM; other territories got Budjerah/Antytila/Ellinoora/Ultimo/1.Cuz versions) — so regional variants run to 24 tracks.
